text:
Mia Chen: Quick sync — final social push plan for the May 6 webinar. Need X + LinkedIn post copy, hero image, 30s GIF, and one benchmark stat to lead with. Drop assets/ETAs here please.
Sam Patel: I can draft the X copy today. Will do 2 headline variants for A/B. ETA 3pm PST.
Jordan Lee: Happy to take LinkedIn longform. Can we use the '2x throughput, 30% cost reduction' stat from the bench?
Mia Chen: That bench stat works if we can cite the workload (low-latency chat). Jordan, can you add a short line about the test context?
Jordan Lee: Yep — will add parentheses: (internal benchmark: 99th pctl latency reduced 2x on small-chat workload).
Alex Rivera: I'll produce hero image + 30s GIF. Can you confirm aspect ratios?
Mia Chen: X single-image 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x628, GIF 1200x675 for the tweet. PNG for hero, animated MP4/GIF for the clip.
Alex Rivera: Got it. Aiming EOD tomorrow for static + draft GIF preview by Wed morning.
Nina Gomez: For inbound routing — can we send webinar signups to SDR queue "webinar_may6" with UTM campaign = webinar_may6_social? Also want a 24h and 72h nurture email.
Sam Patel: Yes. I'll include UTM on all CTA links. Quick note on copy variants: short X (headline + CTA) and X-thread (3 tweets) for high-engagement windows.
Mia Chen: We should schedule the X-thread at 11am PT day-of for max reach, single posts at 9am and 3pm PT for LinkedIn. Ops: can we reserve the 11am slot? @schedule-bot?
schedule-bot: Draft post slots checked — 11:00 PT on 2026-05-06 is available and reserved for #marketing. Reminder will post 24h prior.
Sam Patel: Drafts attached: Variant A (snappy): "Ship faster, pay less — see how we cut inference cost by 30% for low-latency chat. Join our webinar May 6. 👉 [link]?utm=webinar_may6_social"
Sam Patel: Variant B (question): "What if inference got cheaper and faster? We did. Demo + benchmarks on May 6. RSVP: [link]?utm=webinar_may6_social"
Jordan Lee: LinkedIn draft attached. Longer narrative + one bullet on benchmarks and one on deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private).
Alex Rivera: Uploading image drafts: https://drive.redwood/example/hero_v1.png and GIF preview https://drive.redwood/example/gif_preview.mp4 :camera_with_flash: 
Nina Gomez: For lead routing ensure the webhook to HubSpot tags leads with "source=social" and "campaign=webinar_may6". I'll add the mapping to the ops ticket.
Mia Chen: Perfect. Also: engagement follow-ups — social team to track top replies and escalate to ops for warm outreach. Who's owning monitoring?
Jordan Lee: I can monitor first 2 hours after thread drops. Sam can pick up the evening window.
Sam Patel: I'll do 3–6pm PT monitoring + thread replies. Will pull top 10 engagers into a list for SDRs.
Mia Chen: Awesome. One last ask — include a 1-sentence benchmark callout for the hero image (keep under 10 words). Options: 
```
2x throughput, 30% lower cost
Reduced latency, higher throughput
Lower cost, predictable latency
```
Sam Patel: Leaning "2x throughput, 30% lower cost" — bold and punchy.
Alex Rivera: That fits visually. Will mock with white text on gradient.
Mia Chen: Great — timeline recap: Sam drafts X copies today; Jordan finalizes LinkedIn by tomorrow; Alex delivers images by EOD tomorrow, GIF Wed AM; Nina wires routing & HubSpot mapping by Thurs; schedule-bot reserved day-of slot. We'll reconvene in this thread if anything slips. Thanks all :rocket:
